serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Vastian (MediaLab by Vastian) is a web-based Software-as-
a-Service (SaaS) platform that helps healthcare
organizations and other regulated entities manage quality,
compliance, workforce readiness, and operational
workflows. The platform provides integrated capabilities for
document management, inspection and survey readiness,
competency and personnel management, continuing
education and training, event and incident management,
performance improvement, workflow automation, and
reporting. Configurable workflows, role-based access
controls, and centralized data management help
organizations standardize processes, maintain compliance,
improve operational efficiency, and support readiness
across clinical, laboratory, and enterprise operations.
Implementation, training, and technical support services are
available as part of the offering.
